senses.definition: A V-shaped arm in a videocassette recorder that threads the tape of the videocassette around the head.

senses.example: After a year of seriously dating, she was ready to hand over her V card and make him her first.

senses.definition: An internal combustion engine configuration consisting of two cylinder banks—usually with the same number of cylinders in each bank—connected to a common crankshaft, and arranged at an angle to each other so as to form a V shape when viewed from the front of the engine.
A chevron-shaped formation of flying birds or aircraft, used in particular by many migrating birds such as geese.

senses.definition: Any heavy, unstable subatomic particle that decays into a pair of particles, thereby producing a characteristic letter V in a bubble chamber or other detector.
A sign of victory or peace made by raising the index and middle fingers with the palm outwards.
A gesture of contempt or insult made by raising the index and middle fingers with the palm inwards; apocryphally originated by English bowmen at Agincourt (in actuality attested only from 1901).
Any of a group of standard airspeeds.
A triad in which one person is in a polyamorous relationship with two other people who are not in a relationship with each other.
Moxostoma pappillosum, a freshwater catostomid fish of eastern North America.
A valley that resembles the letter V and is formed by erosion from a river or stream over time.
